summary: Big Mountain steel lookout tower in Webster County, WV: cab lost before 2004, tower removed 2008-2010; foundations photographed 2010.

facts.status_note: Cab lost before 2004; steel tower removed between May 2008 and June 2010; foundations photographed in June 2010

events.note: Register photo dated October 2007 shows the tower minus its cab
Register's Removed field gives 'between May 2008 and June 2010'; 2010 is the end of that window, not a single date
Register photo dated June 2010 shows tower foundations at the site
Registered July 8, 2017 on the Former Fire Lookout Sites register (US 1702, WV 87); nominated by Brian Powell

evidence.supports: tower stood on the summit of Big Mountain in western Webster County; views of the Elk River watershed and upper Sutton Lake
evidence.quote: Big Mountain Lookout Tower stood atop the summit of Big Mountain in western Webster County, providing views of the Elk River watershed including the upper end of Sutton Lake.

evidence.supports: administered by the West Virginia Division of Forestry
evidence.quote: Administered by West Virginia Division of Forestry
The tower lost its cab sometime prior to 2004.

evidence.supports: steel tower removed between May 2008 and June 2010
evidence.quote: The steel tower itself was removed sometime between May 2008 and June 2010.

evidence.supports: register photo from October 2007 shows the tower minus its cab
register photo from June 2010 shows tower foundations
register links a geocache at the site of the tower
evidence.quote: Big Mountain Lookout Tower geocache at site of tower

evidence.supports: registered on the FFLOS register on July 8, 2017
FireLookout.org state list marks Big Mountain as gone

evidence.quote: After decades of service West Virginia's forest fire towers were closed in 1990.

evidence.quote: Less than a dozen remain standing today, and none is in service.

notes_for_editor: Only one source describes this tower in detail (the FFLOS register). No build date, staffing or fire history turned up in the sources read; the easternuslookouts.weebly.com 'Big Mountain' section is a heading and a line only. The brief's removal event (2010) is the end of the register's 'between May 2008 and June 2010' window, so it is kept as approximate. The geocache page coord.info/GC6010 returned only its title, so it is not cited; the register names the cache. Access level is not given because no source says whether the site is public. Brief coordinates and elevation (700 m) match the register and FireLookout.org list, so no corrections are proposed.
